name: Invisible ~Toumei Ningen ni Naru Kusuri.
source:
Main character's father is a self-proclaimed genius scientist who invents powder of invisibility one day. Protagonist knows how to use it right to have some fun.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的父親自稱天才科學家，某天發明了隱形粉末。主角知道該如何正確使用它來尋歡作樂。
